summary: Athlete Self-Registration via Email Invite feature tested - CRITICAL BUG FIXED: create_token() was missing required 'role' argument causing 500 errors on registration. After fix, all 15 backend tests pass and frontend UI works correctly.

fixed.issue: create_token() called with only user_id, missing required 'role' argument
fixed.fix: Added role argument: create_token(user_id, 'athlete') and create_token(parent_id, 'parent')

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Lines 1996, 2075, 1628 in server.py - create_token() was missing the 'role' parameter causing TypeError and 500 errors

All invite endpoints now work correctly: POST /api/athletes/invite, GET /api/athletes/invite-info/{token}, POST /api/athletes/invite-register, GET /api/athletes/invitations, DELETE /api/athletes/invitations/{id}
Admin notifications are correctly created when athlete registers via invite (type: 'athlete_registered')
Frontend 'Invita via Email' button is visible and functional on /admin/athletes page
Public /invite-register page correctly loads invitation data and shows registration form
seed_data_creation: Multiple test invitations created during testing (cleaned up automatically by status change)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Athlete invitation flow is now fully working. Bug was in create_token() missing role argument. All endpoints: POST /api/athletes/invite (admin only), GET /api/athletes/invite-info/{token} (public), POST /api/athletes/invite-register (public), GET /api/athletes/invitations (admin), DELETE /api/athletes/invitations/{id} (admin) are working. Frontend shows green 'Invita via Email' button on /admin/athletes page that opens modal. Public /invite-register?token=xxx page pre-fills data from invitation.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The create_token() function requires 2 arguments (user_id, role) but was called with only 1 argument in 3 places: lines 1628, 1996, 2075 in server.py
reproduction_steps: 2. User clicks registration link and fills form
4. Server crashes with TypeError: create_token() missing 1 required positional argument: 'role'
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Added the missing 'role' argument to all create_token() calls: 'athlete' for adult athletes, 'parent' for minor athlete parents
